run_benchmark_comparison: run a benchmark comparing STL, Thrust, and Bolt implementations for a given algorithm across input sizes
plot_benchmark_results: plot benchmark results as a log-log scatter plot showing size versus time in milliseconds
generate_perf_plots: generate performance comparison plots for accumulate, count, merge, sort, and other algorithms
review_plot_to_file: review the plot_to_file function that creates log-log plots from benchmark report samples
refactor_run_benchmark: refactor the run_benchmark call to include additional implementations or custom size ranges
